إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتۡ
When the sky has split [open]
When the sky is split open
When the sky ruptures because of the angels descending from it.
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ
وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
and gives ear to its Lord as it should
And listens submissively to its Lord, as it rightly should.
وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
وَإِذَا ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مُدَّتۡ
And when the earth has been extended
When the earth is spread out
When the earth is stretched by Allah as leather is stretched.
وَإِذَا الْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
وَأَلۡقَتۡ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتۡ
And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
and throws out what is in it, emptying itself
And throws out the treasures and the dead in it and becomes rid of them.
وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
and gives ear to its Lord as it should
And listens submissively to its Lord, as it rightly should.
وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحࣰ ا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it
O man! You are labouring toward your Lord laboriously, and you will encounter Him
O man, you are either doing good or evil and you will meet it on the Day of Judgment, so that Allah can give you the recompense for that.
يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنْسَانُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَاقِيهِ
فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand
Then, as for him who is given his record [of deeds] in his right hand
Since Allah mentioned man’s action in brief, he details the condition of those who did action on the day of judgment by saying: As for him who is given his book of deeds in his right hand.
فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ
فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابࣰ ا يَسِيرࣰ ا
He will be judged with an easy account
he will receive an easy reckoning
He will have an easy reckoning by Allah and his actions will be presented to Him without his being taken to task.
فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورࣰ ا
And return to his people in happiness
and he will return to his folks joyfully
And he will return to his family delighted.
وَيَنْقَلِبُ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا
وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
But as for he who is given his record behind his back
But as for him who is given his record from behind his back
As for him who is given his book in his left hand behind his back.
وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِهِ
فَسَوۡفَ يَدۡعُواْ ثُبُورࣰ ا
He will cry out for destruction
he will pray for annihilation
He will call out for destruction to himself.
فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُو ثُبُورًا
وَيَصۡلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
And [enter to] burn in a Blaze
and enter the Blaze
And he will enter the fire of Hell to suffer from its heat.
وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورًا
Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness
Indeed he used to be joyful among his folk
In the world he was amongst his family rejoicing with his acts of disbelief and sins.
إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِي أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا
إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah]
and he thought that he would never return
He thought that he will not come back to life after death.
إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ يَحُورَ
بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرࣰ ا
But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing
Yes, his Lord had been watching him

Indeed, Allah will bring him back to life just as He created him the first time. His Lord was watchful of his condition. Nothing of that was hidden from Him and He will give him the recompense for his actions.
بَلَىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا
فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
So I swear by the twilight glow
I swear by the evening glow
Allah took an oath by the redness that is in the horizon after the sun sets.
فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالشَّفَقِ
وَٱلَّيۡلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
And [by] the night and what it envelops
by the night and what it is fraught with
And He took an oath by the night and what is gathered therein.
وَاللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
وَٱلۡقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
And [by] the moon when it becomes full
by the moon when it blooms full
And the moon when it comes together and is complete becoming a full moon.
وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا اتَّسَقَ
لَتَرۡكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقࣲ
[That] you will surely experience state after state
you will surely fare from stage to stage
You, O man, will mount one state after another from a drop, then a clot, then a piece of flesh, then life, then death and then resurrection.
لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَنْ طَبَقٍ
فَمَا لَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe
What is the matter with them that they will not believe
What is the matter with these disbelievers who do not have faith in Allah and the last day?!
فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]
and will not prostrate when the Quran is recited to them
When the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate to their Lord?!
وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ
But those who have disbelieved deny
Indeed, the faithless impugn [the Apostle]
In fact, those who disbelieve reject what their messengers brought to them.
بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُكَذِّبُونَ
وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves
and Allah knows best what they keep to themselves
Allah knows well what is contained in their hearts. Nothing of their actions is hidden from Him.
وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
فَبَشِّرۡهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
So give them tidings of a painful punishment
So inform them of a painful punishment
Tell them, O Messenger, about a painful punishment that awaits them.
فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted
excepting such as are faithful and do righteous deeds: for them there will be an everlasting reward
Except those who have faith in Allah and do good deeds, for them is a reward that will never terminate: Paradise.
إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
